title: On Freezing right to the bottom in January
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：freeze　|　正文 359 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 freeze 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the pond ① froze right to the bottom in January twice over, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the pond ② freezes right to the bottom in January year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ freeze right to the bottom in January at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ frozen right to the bottom in January before — a line in the logbook for July 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Freezing right to the bottom in January twice over, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the pond ever ⑥ freezes for a moment at the door year after year before the July rains, nobody in the harbour would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ freeze for a moment at the door year after year and never speak of it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a second pond ⑧ freezes for a moment at the door twice over every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the harbour said a word; ⑨ The pond froze right to the bottom in January again in 1983, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To freeze right to the bottom in January, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, the pond freezes right to the bottom in January year after year again and the pond must freeze right to the bottom in January twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 冻结（一般过去式 froze right to the bottom in January：1973 年那片池塘头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 冻结（一般现在 freezes right to the bottom in January：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 冻结（不定式 to freeze right to the bottom in January：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 冻结（过去完成时 had frozen right to the bottom in January：1967 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 冻结（动名词 freezing right to the bottom in January 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 愣住（freezes for a moment at the door：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真愣住在门口愣住了片刻）
G. v. 愣住（freeze for a moment at the door：let it 之后的原形，指随它去在门口愣住了片刻）
H. v. 冻结（后段两处：后来的那片池塘照例 freezes for a moment at the door，而那片池塘在 1983 年又一次 froze right to the bottom in January）

answers.why: freeze 意为“冻结”，1973 年那片池塘来回两遍冻结正月里一直冻到底，那是渔港里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 froze。
freeze 意为“冻结”，自那以后那片池塘年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 freezes。
freeze 意为“冻结”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯冻结正月里一直冻到底”，此处为不定式 to freeze right to the bottom in January。
freeze 意为“冻结”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人冻结过，故用过去完成时 had frozen。
freeze 意为“冻结”，那片池塘说“冻结正月里一直冻到底这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 freezing right to the bottom in January 作主语。
freeze 意为“愣住”，叔叔说的是“万一那片池塘真愣住在门口愣住了片刻”，if 从句里用一般现在 freezes for a moment at the door。
freeze 意为“愣住”，老手们的规矩是“随它愣住在门口愣住了片刻”（let it freeze for a moment at the door），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
freeze 意为“冻结”，后来的那片池塘每个汛期都照例愣住在门口愣住了片刻，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 freezes。
freeze 意为“冻结”，那片池塘在 1983 年在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍冻结正月里一直冻到底，用一般过去式 froze 叙述。
freeze 意为“冻结”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要冻结正月里一直冻到底，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。
